subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: What first-class Projects MVP should OpenClaw own in core, and should project-scoped tools, skills, workspaces, and runtime constraints be warn-only metadata or enforced policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but storage ownership, Gateway protocol contract, dashboard hierarchy, upgrade behavior, and security semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Core Projects MVP
options.body: Add a narrow durable Project model, additive `projects.*` Gateway methods, Projects dashboard UI, Project-to-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

options.title: Session Grouping Only
options.body: Use existing session labels/categories and UI grouping for the first iteration while deferring Project storage and enforcement.

options.title: Defer Core Projects
options.body: Leave core unchanged until a missing plugin/API extension point is identified and approved.

recommendation.title: Core Projects MVP
recommendation.body: Add a narrow durable Project model, additive `projects.*` Gateway methods, Projects dashboard UI, Project-to-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the project owner in CONTRIBUTING.md and already gave the prior keep-open routing signal for this canonical Projects tracker.
